scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "mvn -f apps/server/pom.xml spring-boot:run" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: mvn -f apps/server/pom.xml package && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build -w @cloud-wa/web && npm run pack -w @cloud-wa/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build -w @cloud-wa/web && npm run dist -w @cloud-wa/desktop
